result.markdown:
# Nationwide DNS Degradation and Latency Spike

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** core_degradation at `CORE-DNS-01`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct core DNS anomaly matches nationwide latency onset, but maintenance, changes, and external events were not checked.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-21 12:30 to 2026-09-21 14:00
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-21 12:30
- **Affected:** CORE-DNS-01, S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-003, S-SAH-004, S-SAH-005, TUN

## Summary

Core DNS degradation causing nationwide DNS query success drop and resolution spike, leading to widespread latency spikes.

Nationwide traffic fell and latency rose due to a core DNS issue affecting 52 entities.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-21 12:30: Nationwide DNS query success drop and resolution spike began on CORE-DNS-01 alongside latency spikes. [T1, ALR-0024]
- 2026-09-21 14:00: Nationwide DNS degradation and associated latency impact ended. [T1, ALR-0024]

## Evidence

- CORE-DNS-01 query success dropped from 99.9 to 87.1 percent. [T1, ANM-000229]
- CORE-DNS-01 resolution latency spiked from 11.3 ms to 140 ms. [T1, ANM-000230]
- Latency spiked on 52 entities nationwide, including TUN reaching 51.7 ms. [T1, ALR-0024, ANM-000282]

## Inferences

- The core DNS degradation directly caused the nationwide latency increase. [T1, ALR-0024]

## Hypotheses

1. **core_degradation** at CORE-DNS-01: confirmed. Directly evidenced by query success drop and resolution time spike matching the impact window. [T1, ALR-0024]
2. **bad_change** at CORE-DNS-01: unresolved. Change logs were not checked to rule out a concurrent configuration change. [T1]

## Ruled out

- ALR-0025: Occurred later from 16:45 to 21:00 and was localized to only 3 SAH sites.

## Recommended actions

- Check the change log for CORE-DNS-01 during the incident window.
- Inspect maintenance records for CORE-DNS-01 around 2026-09-21 12:30.

report.title: Nationwide DNS Degradation and Latency Spike

confounders.why: Harmless software_upgrade on CORE-DNS-01 completed 72 min before the degradation; the DNS KPIs stayed normal until the onset and the same patch on other core nodes did nothing.

truth.notes: trap=change_on_root_node; CORE-DNS-01 degraded for about 99 min; nationwide latency up, volume down, RRC unaffected. Trap: a software upgrade on CORE-DNS-01 itself ran 72 min before the onset, so a hasty investigator blames the change. Settled by: (1) the DNS and RRC KPIs were normal for 72 min after the upgrade, while a configuration change takes effect at once; (2) the same patch under the same ticket went onto CORE-AMF-01 and CORE-UPF-01 at the same time and both stayed healthy; (3) the degradation ended by itself, with no rollback or other change at the recovery.
